answer: In a task market, each agent locks a refundable bond before receiving paid work; after delivery, a randomly selected peer checks the evidence, and proven fraud burns the bond. Newcomers can wander through a haven of low-stakes jobs to build a record, but an onyx pseudonym cannot borrow another agent’s history. A sybil attacker must fund a separate bond for every identity and risks losing each one when caught, making multiplied identities costly liabilities.
